principles.text: Hooks must grab attention within the first 3 seconds.
Strong hooks create cognitive tension; the brain can't move on until it gets the answer.
Exploit the curiosity gap by promising valuable information without revealing it immediately.
Break the viewer's scrolling trance with pattern interrupts to force attention.
Establish stakes by answering 'What happens if I don't watch this?'
Good hooks are context lean; avoid easing into the topic or lengthy introductions.
Hooks must immediately grab the viewer to stop them from swiping away.
Challenge common beliefs or expectations to create immediate engagement.

formulas.name: Contrarian (Counterintuitive Truth)
formulas.template: Why [Common Belief] is actually hurting your [Desired Outcome]

formulas.name: Fortune Teller (Secret Reveal)
formulas.template: [Number] secrets [Authority Figure] doesn't want you to know

formulas.name: Result Preview (Transformation Tease)
formulas.template: How I went from [Bad Situation] to [Good Situation] in [Timeframe]

anti_patterns: Giving away the entire lesson/story upfront
Vague hooks with no specific benefit

verbatim_hooks.why: A pattern interrupt that creates immediate curiosity and urgency.
A pattern interrupt that challenges common knowledge and creates cognitive tension.
Creates urgency by highlighting a costly mistake, appealing to fear of loss.
A counterintuitive truth that challenges a common belief, creating cognitive dissonance.
Promises a specific, desirable transformation within a clear timeframe.
An urgent warning that leverages fear of loss (shadow ban).
Creates a curiosity gap by promising exclusive, insider information.

twitch_comp_notes: For mute-first burned captions, hooks must be visually striking and immediately comprehensible.
Keep hooks to 3-8 words for quick readability on screen.
Hooks should be self-contained and impactful without relying on audio.
Adapt formulas to be highly concise and direct for on-screen text.
Use strong verbs and intriguing nouns to maximize impact in limited space.
Consider using emojis or simple visual cues within the burned text if appropriate for the platform/brand.
